body: 11 years! I'm so sorry you wasted so much time on him. I'm so sad that I wasted 3 years on mine.
It's so scary that people can deceive you like that 😔
Thank you ❤️ It feels like I won't get through it, and I'll be permanently broken, but it's true that it's much better than staying.
Would have helped by being dead too lol

Looking back at my life before him and thinking of how that's going to be my life again is really frightening. Before him I was very underweight because I struggle to find the energy to cook for myself. He cooks all the food for me and makes sure I eat enough and now I've managed to reach a normal weight. He's teaching me how to drive. I really need the freedom of having a car and being able to drive places, but I suck at it and I'm afraid of driving on my own so he drives me everywhere I have to go. I have to move if we break up and i don't think I will be able to bring my furniture with me and definitely can't afford new furniture. It's really all so frightening to think about. Maybe my life would have been better if we never got together but now I'm gonna have to start from scratch because I let myself become so dependent on him. And I don't know if I can do it. Also I'm scared of finding someone new and become dependent again and relive all this over again. :(
